data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A'imana, meaning to believe or trust. In Islamic context, Aeman is a name for someone who has imaan, or faith in Allah. The name Aeman carries the meaning “Faithful, Trustworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aeman usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, trustworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aeman total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
